feedback: The candidate shows improved progress and slightly reduced RMS error compared to the previous iteration, indicating better tracking performance. However, it still fails to complete the tracks and experiences 2 line loss events per trial, with notable steering oscillations (up to 0.224 on the s-bend). Control effort remains moderate to high, suggesting the controller is working hard but not fully stabilizing the robot. The increased kp and kd have likely improved responsiveness and damping, and the moderate increase in ki helps steady-state error correction without overshoot. To further improve completion likelihood and reduce line loss, consider slightly increasing kd further (e.g., to 0.07) to enhance damping of oscillations, and reduce ki slightly (e.g., to 0.10) to avoid potential integral windup that might cause oscillations. Also, consider testing a slightly lower base_speed (e.g., 0.13) to improve stability on curves without sacrificing much progress. These changes aim to reduce steering oscillations and line loss events, improving completion rates. Confirm improvements by monitoring completion, line_loss_events, rms_error, and steering_oscillation in the next race.
